clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12385 (the held text of the table prints the numbers and the subject lines in separate blocks, so the row is identified here by its number alone and the subject is taken from the order’s own heading). The five numbered paragraphs (1-101 to 1-105) establish, effective October 1, 1982, a three-member board under section 510 of the Rail Passenger Service Act (45 U.S.C. 590), subject to the availability of funds, and direct a public hearing, an initial report within 30 days after creation, the submission of final offers if the dispute is not settled within ten days after the report, and a final report within 15 days after the final offers. The command to create the board was performed when the board was appointed, but under owner ruling 2026-10-21 the order is not treated as ended by that performance or by the report. Under owner ruling 2026-10-21 (report deadlines, option C) a report deadline is not an end: the command is functionally spent when the board reports, but the order remained on the books until this revocation. The actual report date is not recorded as a later event because no report text is among this packet’s citable evidence. No earlier express end was found.

It creates a board to investigate the dispute between New Jersey Transit Rail Operations, Inc. and certain labor organizations.
